content: Singular . SINGLE BOOK .  Frank is retired, well forced out of the military and now lives in a small town, off the small pension the army gives him, one day an accident wakes up the device  the  military had placed in his head as a test and soon he finds himself hunted by companies and the government alike .  Machine is buried in his head Something happens after frank is shocked and the machine begins to connect to the internet and  talking to frank, soon they find themselves at the center of a conspiracy as he is now hunted and desperately trying to survive .  Frank Powell Staff Sergeant (Retired) Frank is a loner, living off the meager  pension  that the army left him. Once on the fast track for command Powell volunteered for an experimental project and had a small  tactical  computer inserted into his head,  During the surgery something happened and Frank was left with minimal use of his legs and arms, no longer fit for the army he was discharged, the machine left in his head after deemed  to  dangerous to take out.  One day  Frank was fixing the electricity in his home when he shocked himself, after that strange things begin to happen and he realizes that a voice has begun talking to him, one from within his head.
